plugin.description: A catalog of every mob in the game (16k+ models, 15.5k named) plus the full set of humanoid NPCs (Glamourer's NPC tab). Apply any mob's or NPC's look to yourself client-side (Brio-style ModelCharaId swap + redraw, or a Glamourer paint for humans), spawn disguised puppets, trigger action timelines for theatrics, and revert cleanly. Self-apply only, like Glamourer — never enforced on other players. Built for DM/event use — no mechanics, just the face.
plugin.summary: Wear any monster's face. Client-side mob disguises with a searchable catalog and animation triggers.

website.description: Client-side mob disguises for FFXIV. A DM/event tool with a searchable NPC catalog and animation triggers.
website.readmeExcerpt:
# HDM

Apply any NPC or monster's appearance to your own character, client-side, for
DM and roleplay events. A module for HMS.

## Commands

`/hdm`

## License

AGPL-3.0-or-later. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
